blocks.en: Appendix 2: References

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Reference Overview / 參考資料總覽
blocks.en: Reference Overview

blocks.zh: 參考資料導讀
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 本附錄收錄了 ISPE 第三卷全書引用的 71 份參考文獻。這些文獻涵蓋法規指引、國際標準、藥典章節、ISPE 指南、PDA 技術報告及學術文獻，構成無菌製造設施設計、建造與營運的完整知識基礎。
blocks.en: This appendix lists the 71 references cited throughout ISPE Volume 3. They cover regulatory guidance, international standards, pharmacopoeial chapters, ISPE guides, PDA technical reports and academic literature, and together form the knowledge base for the design, construction and operation of sterile manufacturing facilities.

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 從業者而言，不需要逐一熟讀全部 71 份文獻，但應根據職責範圍掌握核心文件。以下分類整理有助於快速定位重點。
blocks.en: CDMO professionals do not need to read all 71 references in detail, but they should master the core documents relevant to their responsibilities. The groupings below help you find the key ones quickly.

blocks.zh: Regulatory & GMP References / 法規類參考文獻
blocks.en: Regulatory & GMP References

blocks.zh: 法規文獻解讀
blocks.en: Reading the Regulatory Documents

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（Ref 1）是全球無菌製造最重要的法規文件。2022年修訂版大幅強化了污染控制策略（CCS）、無菌製程模擬（APS）及環境監測要求。所有 CDMO 從業者必讀。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (Ref 1) is the most important regulatory document for sterile manufacturing worldwide. The 2022 revision significantly strengthened the requirements for the contamination control strategy (CCS), aseptic process simulation (APS) and environmental monitoring. It is required reading for all CDMO professionals.

blocks.zh: FDA 無菌製程指引（Ref 3）是美國市場的核心法規依據，雖然發布於 2004 年，但至今仍為 FDA 查廠的主要參考標準。與 Annex 1 搭配閱讀可建立完整的全球法規視角。
blocks.en: The FDA Aseptic Processing guidance (Ref 3) is the core regulatory basis for the US market. Although published in 2004, it remains the main reference standard for FDA inspections. Read alongside Annex 1, it gives a complete global regulatory perspective.

blocks.zh: PIC/S PE 009（Ref 9）是全球超過 50 個會員國採用的 GMP 指引框架，對於出口多國市場的 CDMO 尤為重要。
blocks.en: PIC/S PE 009 (Ref 9) is the GMP guidance framework adopted by more than 50 participating authorities worldwide, and is especially important for CDMOs that export to multiple markets.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11（Ref 43）及 Annex 11（Ref 63）是電子紀錄與電子簽章的法規基礎，在數位化轉型中越來越重要。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 (Ref 43) and Annex 11 (Ref 63) are the regulatory foundation for electronic records and electronic signatures, and are becoming increasingly important in digital transformation.

blocks.zh: Must-Read Regulatory Documents / 法規必讀清單
blocks.en: Must-Read Regulatory Documents

blocks.zh: Ref 1 – EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 Rev.)：無菌製造的全球黃金標準，2023年8月生效
blocks.en: Ref 1 – EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 Rev.): the global gold standard for sterile manufacturing, in effect from August 2023

blocks.zh: Ref 3 – FDA Aseptic Processing：美國市場查廠核心依據
blocks.en: Ref 3 – FDA Aseptic Processing: the core basis for inspections in the US market

blocks.zh: Ref 17 – FDA Process Validation：製程驗證生命週期方法論
blocks.en: Ref 17 – FDA Process Validation: the lifecycle approach to process validation

blocks.zh: Ref 18 – Annex 15：歐盟確效與驗證要求
blocks.en: Ref 18 – Annex 15: EU requirements for qualification and validation

blocks.zh: Ref 9 – PIC/S PE 009：多國市場 GMP 基準
blocks.en: Ref 9 – PIC/S PE 009: the GMP benchmark for multi-country markets

blocks.zh: ICH Guidelines / ICH 指引
blocks.en: ICH Guidelines

blocks.zh: ICH 指引體系說明
blocks.en: The ICH Guideline System

blocks.zh: ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 構成品質管理的「鐵三角」：
blocks.en: ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 form the "iron triangle" of quality management:

blocks.zh: Q8 藥學開發：設計空間（Design Space）概念，為設施設計提供科學基礎
blocks.en: Q8 Pharmaceutical Development: the design space concept, which provides the scientific basis for facility design

blocks.zh: Q9 品質風險管理：FMEA、FTA 等工具的應用框架，直接影響設施風險評估
blocks.en: Q9 Quality Risk Management: the application framework for tools such as FMEA and FTA, with a direct impact on facility risk assessment

blocks.zh: Q10 藥品品質系統：管理審查、CAPA、變更管制的系統性框架
blocks.en: Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System: the systematic framework for management review, CAPA and change control

blocks.zh: Q7（Ref 6）針對 API 製造，與本指南的終產品無菌設施設計互補。Q11（Ref 7）則涵蓋藥物物質的開發與製造。
blocks.en: Q7 (Ref 6) addresses API manufacturing and complements this guide's focus on sterile finished-product facility design. Q11 (Ref 7) covers the development and manufacture of drug substances.

blocks.zh: ISO Standards / ISO 標準
blocks.en: ISO Standards

blocks.zh: ISO 標準體系解說
blocks.en: The ISO Standards System

blocks.zh: ISO 14644 系列是潔淨室設計與驗證的國際標準基礎，本指南引用了該系列的 7 個部分：
blocks.en: The ISO 14644 series is the international standards foundation for cleanroom design and qualification. This guide cites 7 parts of the series:

blocks.zh: Part 1（Ref 4）：空氣潔淨度分級 — 定義 ISO Class 5/7/8 等級別，是設施設計的起點
blocks.en: Part 1 (Ref 4): classification of air cleanliness. It defines classes such as ISO Class 5/7/8 and is the starting point for facility design

blocks.zh: Part 2（Ref 42）：潔淨室性能監測 — 確認持續符合等級要求
blocks.en: Part 2 (Ref 42): monitoring of cleanroom performance, to confirm continued compliance with the class requirements

blocks.zh: Part 3（Ref 31）：測試方法 — 粒子計數、風速測量等驗證方法
blocks.en: Part 3 (Ref 31): test methods, such as particle counting and air velocity measurement used in qualification

blocks.zh: Part 4（Ref 29）：設計、建造與啟動 — 設施工程實務
blocks.en: Part 4 (Ref 29): design, construction and start-up, covering facility engineering practice

blocks.zh: Part 7（Ref 20）：隔離裝置 — 隔離器、手套箱等分隔設備
blocks.en: Part 7 (Ref 20): separative devices, such as isolators and glove boxes

blocks.zh: Part 13（Ref 36）：表面清潔 — 達到定義潔淨度的清潔方法
blocks.en: Part 13 (Ref 36): cleaning of surfaces, with cleaning methods to achieve a defined level of cleanliness

blocks.zh: ISO 13408（Ref 5）是無菌加工的專門標準，與 ISO 14644 互補，涵蓋無菌製程的一般要求。
blocks.en: ISO 13408 (Ref 5) is the dedicated standard for aseptic processing. It complements ISO 14644 and covers the general requirements for aseptic processes.

blocks.zh: ISO 8573（Ref 49）定義壓縮空氣品質等級，對製程氣體系統設計至關重要。
blocks.en: ISO 8573 (Ref 49) defines compressed air quality classes and is critical to the design of process gas systems.

blocks.zh: ISPE Guides / ISPE 指南
blocks.en: ISPE Guides

blocks.zh: ISPE 指南體系導覽
blocks.en: Overview of the ISPE Guides

blocks.zh: 本指南引用了 ISPE 旗下 14 份文獻，涵蓋 Baseline Guide（基準指南）、Good Practice Guide（良好實務指南）及 GAMP（自動化系統驗證）三大系列。
blocks.en: This guide cites 14 ISPE documents, covering three series: Baseline Guides, Good Practice Guides and GAMP (validation of automated systems).

blocks.zh: Baseline Guide 系列是 ISPE 的旗艦出版物，每卷針對特定設施類型或系統提供工程設計指引：
blocks.en: The Baseline Guide series is ISPE's flagship publication, with each volume providing engineering design guidance for a specific facility type or system:

blocks.zh: Vol. 1（Ref 8）：原料藥設施
blocks.en: Vol. 1 (Ref 8): active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) facilities

blocks.zh: Vol. 4（Ref 46）：水與蒸汽系統 — 無菌設施的生命線
blocks.en: Vol. 4 (Ref 46): water and steam systems, the lifeline of a sterile facility

blocks.zh: Vol. 5（Ref 34）：試車與確效 — 設施啟用的方法論
blocks.en: Vol. 5 (Ref 34): commissioning and qualification, the methodology for bringing a facility into service

blocks.zh: Vol. 6（Ref 14）：生物製藥設施
blocks.en: Vol. 6 (Ref 14): biopharmaceutical facilities

blocks.zh: Vol. 7（Ref 19）：風險導向製造 — QRM 在設施設計中的應用
blocks.en: Vol. 7 (Ref 19): risk-based manufacture, applying QRM to facility design

blocks.zh: Good Practice Guide 系列針對特定工程領域提供實務操作指引：
blocks.en: The Good Practice Guide series provides practical guidance for specific engineering areas:

blocks.zh: HVAC（Ref 28）：空調系統設計 — 潔淨室的核心公用系統
blocks.en: HVAC (Ref 28): air-handling system design, the core utility of a cleanroom

blocks.zh: GEP（Ref 44）：良好工程實務 — 工程專案管理方法
blocks.en: GEP (Ref 44): good engineering practice, the approach to managing engineering projects

blocks.zh: Process Gases（Ref 48）：製程氣體系統
blocks.en: Process Gases (Ref 48): process gas systems

blocks.zh: Water & Steam C&Q（Ref 47）：水系統試車與確效
blocks.en: Water & Steam C&Q (Ref 47): commissioning and qualification of water systems

blocks.zh: GAMP 5（Ref 52）是電腦化系統驗證的業界標準，適用於 BMS、EMS、SCADA 等自動化系統。
blocks.en: GAMP 5 (Ref 52) is the industry standard for computerized system validation and applies to automated systems such as BMS, EMS and SCADA.

blocks.zh: USP & PDA References / 藥典與 PDA 文獻
blocks.en: USP & PDA References

blocks.zh: 藥典與 PDA 文獻說明
blocks.en: About the Pharmacopoeial and PDA References

blocks.zh: USP 章節提供具法律約束力的藥典標準：
blocks.en: USP chapters provide legally binding pharmacopoeial standards:

blocks.zh: <790>（Ref 24）：注射劑目視檢查 — 品質控制的最終把關
blocks.en: <790> (Ref 24): visual inspection of injections, the final quality control checkpoint

blocks.zh: <1207>（Ref 22）：包裝完整性評估 — 確保無菌產品的密封性
blocks.en: <1207> (Ref 22): package integrity evaluation, ensuring the seal integrity of sterile products

blocks.zh: <1229> 系列（Refs 23, 27）：滅菌方法的藥典規範
blocks.en: The <1229> series (Refs 23, 27): pharmacopoeial requirements for sterilization methods

blocks.zh: PDA 技術報告提供深入的技術指引：
blocks.en: PDA Technical Reports provide in-depth technical guidance:

blocks.zh: TR1（Ref 26）：濕熱滅菌驗證 — 高壓蒸汽滅菌的完整方法論
blocks.en: TR1 (Ref 26): validation of moist heat sterilization, a complete methodology for autoclave sterilization

blocks.zh: TR22（Ref 69）：製程模擬（培養基充填）— APS 的業界標準
blocks.en: TR22 (Ref 69): process simulation (media fill), the industry standard for APS

blocks.zh: TR34（Ref 54）：隔離器系統設計與驗證
blocks.en: TR34 (Ref 54): design and validation of isolator systems

blocks.zh: PDA TR Cross-References / PDA 技術報告交叉參照
blocks.en: PDA TR Cross-References

blocks.zh: 本知識庫已完成 TR22（製程模擬）的完整教學版本。TR1（濕熱滅菌）與 TR34（隔離器）的詳細內容可在對應的 PDA 技術報告教學材料中查閱。
blocks.en: This knowledge base already includes a complete teaching version of TR22 (process simulation). Details of TR1 (moist heat sterilization) and TR34 (isolators) can be found in the corresponding PDA technical report training materials.

blocks.zh: Scientific Literature & Other Standards / 學術文獻與其他標準
blocks.en: Scientific Literature & Other Standards

blocks.zh: 工程標準與學術文獻解說
blocks.en: Engineering Standards and Scientific Literature

blocks.zh: 工程標準組織提供設施設計的技術基礎：
blocks.en: Engineering standards bodies provide the technical foundation for facility design:

blocks.zh: ASME BPE（Ref 21）：生物製程設備標準 — 不鏽鋼管路、容器的表面粗糙度與焊接規範
blocks.en: ASME BPE (Ref 21): bioprocessing equipment standard, covering surface roughness and welding requirements for stainless steel piping and vessels

blocks.zh: ASHRAE（Ref 40）：暖通空調工程的全球權威，潔淨室空調設計的技術依據
blocks.en: ASHRAE (Ref 40): the global authority on HVAC engineering and the technical basis for cleanroom air-conditioning design

blocks.zh: IEST（Refs 30, 65）：潔淨室設計的推薦實務
blocks.en: IEST (Refs 30, 65): recommended practices for cleanroom design

blocks.zh: 學術文獻提供科學研究支撐：
blocks.en: Scientific literature provides research support:

blocks.zh: Whyte & Eaton（Refs 16, 32）：潔淨室污染控制與氣流模型的權威研究者
blocks.en: Whyte & Eaton (Refs 16, 32): leading researchers on cleanroom contamination control and airflow modelling

blocks.zh: Sigwarth 系列（Refs 56-58）：H2O2 除污循環與隔離器手套完整性研究，是隔離器技術的核心文獻
blocks.en: The Sigwarth series (Refs 56-58): studies of H2O2 decontamination cycles and isolator glove integrity, core literature for isolator technology

blocks.zh: Agalloco 等（Ref 55）：無菌充填技術選擇的經典論述
blocks.en: Agalloco et al. (Ref 55): the classic discussion of aseptic filling technology selection

blocks.zh: 生物安全（Refs 67-68）在處理高活性或感染性物質時需要參考，特別是疫苗與生物製劑 CDMO。
blocks.en: Biosafety (Refs 67-68) should be consulted when handling highly potent or infectious materials, especially by CDMOs working with vaccines and biologics.

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 摘要
blocks.en: Summary

blocks.zh: 本附錄收錄的 71 份參考文獻構成無菌產品製造設施設計的完整知識體系。從法規要求（EU GMP Annex 1、FDA 指引）到技術標準（ISO 14644 系列）、從品質管理（ICH Q8-Q10）到工程實務（ISPE/ASHRAE/ASME），涵蓋了設施設計所需的所有面向。
blocks.en: The 71 references in this appendix form a complete body of knowledge for the design of sterile product manufacturing facilities. They span regulatory requirements (EU GMP Annex 1, FDA guidance), technical standards (the ISO 14644 series), quality management (ICH Q8-Q10) and engineering practice (ISPE/ASHRAE/ASME), covering every aspect of facility design.
